name: Pinterest
description: Pinterest developer platform API for content, ads, conversions and shopping catalogs.
auth_notes: OAuth 2 authorization flow with app ID, client secret, redirect URI and scopes; MCP example uses a Bearer token.
gate_detail: Requires a business account, verified email and accepting developer terms to register an app. Test tokens need Trial access approval and expire after 24 hours. Sandbox exists for test calls.
api_scope: Manage organic Pins and Boards, ad campaigns and reporting, product catalogs and shopping ads, conversions and analytics.
mcp_notes: Pinterest MCP Server announced with OAuth 2.0; site says it is on the way and not yet publicly launched.
blocker_detail: Trial access approval is mentioned as the gate for test tokens; production access requirements are not detailed in sources.

evidence.quote: Your app ID and client secret
Build a working authentication flow based on OAuth 2
Once your app is approved for Trial access you can generate a token to test the API without setting up the Oauth flow.
Our sandbox environment allows you to make test calls without impacting the Pinterest product environment.
OAuth 2.0 authorization and granular permissions keep credentials protected and access appropriately controlled.

issues: Production access approval process not described in sources.
MCP server appears not yet publicly launched.
Webhooks not mentioned; REST style not explicitly labeled.

searches.query: Pinterest API credentials pricing plan required developer access
